changelog:
Initial release of blog-editorial-calendar: an orchestration layer for automated, balanced blog publishing.

- Maintains a backlog of research-backed topics and automatically refills when empty.
- Picks the next topics based on your target cluster/format mix to keep your content balanced.
- Schedules posts into a rolling daily cadence and marks them done when published.
- Syncs backlog status with what's actually live on your CMS to avoid duplicates.
- Works with blog-topic-research for ideation and seo-blog-writer for publishing; platform-agnostic via adapter.
- Supports commands for topic picking, scheduling, backlog management, and status reporting.
